automationNotes: Doc path: App Switcher → **Personalize** → **Personalize Projects** → project → **Audiences** → **+ New Audience** → **Audience** page **Name** / **Description** → **Rules** → **Add Rule** → **Select attribute** → **Select Operator** → **Select Value** → **Save**. **Prerequisite**: a **custom** attribute must exist in the project (**create-custom-attribute** / API). Matching: **`PERSONALIZE_AUDIENCE_CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE_CONTAINS`** (default **`AUTO_LOYALTY`**) narrows react-select results. **Criterion**: **`step.value`** on Select Value **`or`** **`PERSONALIZE_AUDIENCE_RULE_CRITERION`** (fallback **`AutomationCriterion`**). **Operator**: first actionable menu row after Attribute is selected. **`personalize-nav-audiences`**, **`add-new-audience-button`**, **`audience-add-rule-button`**, **`audience-create-button`**.
